title: Abarinzi b'itongo
intro: Mu murima wari uteye igomwe, umuryango umwe warahiye cane. Ariko umwiyemezo wabo warageragejwe igihe ubugombe bw’Imana bwagira ico bukoze, bugahindura ubutunzi bwabo bukaba igihugu c’ubugaragwa.
clues: Twarahezagiwe n’itongo ryinshi, ariko twaciye twibona.
Twaragize umugambi wo kwimbura tutasangira n’abakene.
Twarasohotse kare mu gitondo, twizigiye umugambi wacu.
Ariko twashitseyo, twasanze itongo ryacu ryasambutse mw’ijoro rimwe.
Twarabonye ikosa ryacu maze dutangura guterana umugayo.
Amaherezo twarihanye, ariko icigwa caciwe carerewe cane.
arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
